title: 005 九宫飞星
content_zh:
“妈，你身体不好，就少喝点可乐。”叶娴拿开母亲黄秀琴眼前的杯子。

“没事，今天女儿回来了，高兴。”黄秀琴拍拍女儿的手，示意自己没事。

“妈，你自己在家都晕倒过两次了，还没事，回头要是真有什么事，你让我和我爸怎么办？”看的出叶娴也是个孝顺的人，她对母亲的关心发自内心。

“哎，妈那都是洗衣服，蹲的久了，突然起来，贫血而已。没事。”

老人总是把自己的病说的比鹅毛还轻，却总是把子女看的比泰山还重。没病没灾的时候，他们不愿意麻烦子女，就算身体不好了，也总是把大病说小。

唐振东突然有种感动，这是种平凡人间的感动，这种亲情他似乎一直都处身其间，但是好像又一直距离很远。

唐振东出狱以后，回过两次家，第一次是刚出狱的时候回过一次，第二次是自己辛苦攒了五千块钱的时候，亲手送回去的。唐振东省吃俭用，一月能存下五六百块钱，除了租房子的一百五十块，然后就是三百块吃喝。三百块钱在现在的城市里能吃什么？而且唐振东还练武，吃的又多。

但是唐振东必须省下钱来带回家。他记得自己父母骤然听说自己杀人入狱时候的震惊与慌张，也记得父母来探监时候那两行浑浊的老泪。

唐振东没什么别的想法，就是想挣点干干净净的钱留着给父母养老。

在农村，一个入狱的杀人犯家庭，可想而知，大家都是怎么看的，唐振东能想象，他的父母在一直受着别人的指指点点，而自己却无能为力。他记得很清楚，自己刚出狱第一次回家的时候，村民看到他的时候，都拉紧了自己的孩子，怕孩子碰到他，沾染上晦气。

可以想象，唐振东从一个镇里都远近闻名的聪明孩子，学习第一，体育第一，突然沦落到监狱中，这种转变，让所有人都接受不了。尤其是自己的父母。

不过父母总是自己的父母，即使出狱的儿子，在他们的心中，依旧是自己的儿子。但是周围人的目光和指指点点，让唐振东感觉自己给父母脸上抹了黑。

所以唐振东很少回家，出狱一年，也不过回家了两趟。他现在过着苦行僧般的生活，就是想通过自己的辛苦劳动，让父母安安心心安度晚年。

今天，突然见到叶娴关心她的母亲，虽然说这是一个子女应该做的，但是仍旧是触动了唐振东的心。儿子不孝，让二老**太多的心。

“老叶，嫂子是心脏不好吧，可不能当成贫血来治。”唐振东出言告诫老叶说。他通过近距离的观察老叶嫂的面相，又加上看到老叶家的风水，所以他明确的知道老叶嫂肯定是心脏不好。

老叶一吃惊，“咦，我跟你说过你嫂子的病吗？”

叶娴也有些吃惊，“爸，你的这个小同事，还会看病？”

老叶一瞪女儿，本来想发点小火，但是许久不见女儿，他的这火也发不出来，“什么小同事，没大没小。”

叶娴可爱的一吐舌头，但是脸上依旧是那副怀疑的模样。

“你去洗点水果给你妈妈吃，在门口，小唐拿的。”老叶一指门口唐振东顺手放在那里的几个塑料袋。

“小唐，以后你来就来，可千万别带什么东西。”老叶嫂也是个实诚人，唐振东能感觉到她眼中的真诚。

“好的，嫂子，下次来我只带着肚子来，呵呵。”

“小唐，我告诉过你嫂子的病吗？”老叶老纠缠在这个问题上，他想了半天了，也没想出来自己什么时候告诉过唐振东叶娴她妈得的什么病。

“这个，老叶，你说过的，难道忘了？”唐振东只能打马虎眼，他自然不能说自己还没进门，只看风水，就能看出这些事来，只能跟老叶打着哈哈。

“哦，我还真不记得了，我先前还以为你会看病呢！”

“你个老叶，真是病急乱投医，小唐不是这行的，怎么会看病呢？”黄秀琴嗔怪道。

“水果来啦，这是新鲜的火龙果，这是橄榄，这是龙眼，哦，还有木瓜，唐哥带的水果真不少，呵呵。”叶娴拿了好几个盘，有些需要剥皮的都剥完，切好，摆在盘子，直接吃就行。

“小唐，真是，你也不容易，这些水果多贵呀，下次来什么也不准带，听见没有？”黄秀琴是个会过日子的人，而且日子也过得节俭的很，这些南方水果在北方都不便宜。她虽然没吃过，但是超市里都摆着，价格都是知道的。

“知道了嫂子，下次只带嘴和肚子来。”唐振东笑笑。

不过叶娴看着唐振东，“你会治病？你真的是看出我妈是心脏病吗？”叶娴洗水果的时候，就在厨房竖起耳朵听着，出来后迫不及待的问。

“娴娴，别瞎说。”黄秀琴在一边轻轻拍了下女儿的手。

“呵呵，嫂子，我还真的会点简单的治病，只是不知道这个病我能不能看好？”其实唐振东对这个病，还是有百分之八十以上的把握的。

唐振东坐着的时候，已经把老叶家的风水摆设看了一个遍，他也找出了老叶家的风水的问题。然后在配合上给老叶嫂弄点固本培元的中药，那这个病其实也没多大的事。

“啊？小唐，你真会看病？我怎么从来没听你说起过？”老叶大惊失色。对于一种从未接触过的领域的一些东西，他只能表现出他的震惊。

要知道自己老伴的这个病，在家里晕倒过两次，都因为及时发现，要不然会有生命危险的。这病也去大医院检查过，医院说要做心脏搭桥手术，最起码要十几万块，所以老叶也在拼命挣钱。

不过挣的总不是存不下多少，因为女儿正上大学，一年学费加生活费最起码也要两三万。虽然女儿自己知道节俭，但是老叶苦了自己也不愿意苦了女儿，所以这钱存了好几年，也没存够。

这次突然听说唐振东能治病，他不禁生出一份希望来。要知道医院的心脏搭桥手术需要十几万，而且手术有风险。而如果唐振东真的有什么秘传古方，那倒是真的有可能在花不了多少钱的情况下，治好老伴的病。

“我试试，不过不一定能成。”对于没有把握的事，唐振东也不敢把话说的太满。毕竟自己只是通晓风水，而不是真正的医师。

唐振东仔细观察过叶家的风水：他是在叶家的风水上发现了问题，风水是个极大的学问，其中没有好脑子的人永远不可能学会风水。因为风水学就是个计算的学问，需要大量繁复的计算。

要定一间屋的风水，首先要知晓九宫飞星。九宫是九宫格，而飞星则是判断什么是当运星。

所谓的当运星则是表示这一年哪个星正当运。从二零零四年到二零二三年的这二十年八运星是当运星。而当运星的计算则是根据木星和土星的运行次数计算出来的，这就属于星相学了，唐振东对以计算为主的星相学也颇有心得。

而计算出的当运星，则是个死的。也就是说当运星二十年变换一次，只要算出这二十年的当运星，就能找到这飞星所伏的方位。

其实每一年、每个月、每一日、每一个时辰都是有当运星的，如果要定每个时辰的吉凶，就需要精确到哪一月哪一日哪一个时辰，这样的计算就更需要精确了。但是话又说回来，风水在很多时候又没有必须非要精确到时辰，因为计算太繁复，等你计算到了时辰，说不定这个时辰就过去了。

但是把握一点，如果这二十年的大运都对不准，那自然后面的年月日时，就都是错的，如果这二十年的大运对准了，那要找毛病，就需要从这一年的当运星上找，如果要继续精确，那就计算月和日。

当然老叶老伴黄秀琴的病不是这三两个月形成的，而是好几年了，所以没必要去那么精确，找到这二十年的当运星就可以。

找到了当运星，也就是飞星所伏的方位，就找到了九宫的坐向。找到了九宫的坐向，按照九宫八卦，那自然就找到了各个方向上所代表的家庭成员。

九宫格分成东，南，西，北，然后东南，西南，东北，西北，一共八个方向，这八个方向与乾坤等八卦相匹配，再加上中间的中宫，正好组成了九宫格。

就拿叶家来说，西南方是代表的母亲，也就是黄秀琴，母则代表八卦中的坤，坤属土，也就是说代表黄秀琴的西南方必须要适宜土的环境，与土相匹配。

与土相匹配的五行是木和水。木克土，土克水。也就是说叶家的西南方适宜有土，而不适应有木的存在。而叶家的西南方的窗台上正好摆放了一盆虎皮兰，就是这盆虎皮兰正好应了木克土的五行相克，从土中心生出了一株虎皮兰，土中心对应着坤卦的心，这可不就是应了黄秀琴中心的心脏部位有毛病？

content_en:
"Mom, if you are not in good health, drink less Coke." Ye Xian took the cup away from her mother Huang Xiuqin's eyes.

"It's okay. I'm happy that my daughter is back today." Huang Xiuqin patted her daughter's hand to indicate that she was okay.

"Mom, you've fainted twice at home, and you're still fine. If something happens later, what do you want me and my dad to do?" It can be seen that Ye Xian is also a filial person, and her concern for her mother comes from the bottom of her heart.

"Hey, Mom was just doing laundry. She woke up suddenly after squatting for a long time. It's just anemia. It's okay."

The old man always says that his illness is less serious than a goose feather, but he always regards his children as more serious than Mount Tai.When there is no illness or disaster, they are not willing to trouble their children. Even if they are not in good health, they always treat serious illness as trivial.

Tang Zhendong suddenly felt touched. It was an ordinary human touch. He seemed to have always been involved in this kind of family affection, but it seemed that he was always far away.

After Tang Zhendong was released from prison, he went back home twice. The first time was when he was just released from prison, and the second time was when he saved 5,000 yuan and sent it back with his own hands.Tang Zhendong lived frugally and was able to save five to six hundred yuan a month. In addition to the 150 yuan for renting a house, he also had 300 yuan for food and drinks.What can you eat with three hundred yuan in today's city?Moreover, Tang Zhendong also practiced martial arts and ate a lot.

But Tang Zhendong had to save money to take home.He remembered the shock and panic of his parents when they suddenly heard that he had committed murder and was imprisoned. He also remembered the two lines of muddy tears when his parents came to visit him in prison.

Tang Zhendong didn't have any other ideas. He just wanted to earn some clean money to keep for his parents' retirement.

In the countryside, you can imagine how everyone would view a family of imprisoned murderers. Tang Zhendong could imagine that his parents were constantly being criticized by others, but he was powerless to do anything about it.He remembered clearly that when he came home for the first time after being released from prison, the villagers tightened their grip on their children when they saw him, fearing that the children would touch him and be contaminated with bad luck.

It is conceivable that Tang Zhendong went from being a smart kid who was well-known in the town, first in studies and first in sports, and suddenly fell into prison. This change was unacceptable to everyone.Especially my own parents.

But parents are always their parents. Even if their son is released from prison, in their hearts, he is still their son.But the looks and pointing fingers from the people around him made Tang Zhendong feel like he had put a black mark on his parents' faces.

Therefore, Tang Zhendong rarely went home. One year after he was released from prison, he only went home twice.He now lives an ascetic life, just wanting to let his parents spend their old age in peace through his hard work.

Today, I suddenly saw Ye Xian caring about her mother. Although this is what a child should do, it still touched Tang Zhendong's heart.The son's unfilial piety caused the two elders to lose too much heart.

"Lao Ye, my sister-in-law has a bad heart, but we can't treat it as anemia." Tang Zhendong warned Lao Ye.By closely observing Mrs. Ye's face and seeing the feng shui of Lao Ye's family, he clearly knew that Mrs. Ye must have a bad heart.

Lao Ye was surprised, "Hey, did I tell you about your sister-in-law's illness?"

Ye Xian was also a little surprised, "Dad, this little colleague of yours can still see a doctor?"

Lao Ye glared at his daughter. He originally wanted to get a little angry, but since he hadn't seen his daughter for a long time, he couldn't express his anger. "You're a little colleague, no big or small."

Ye Xian stuck out her tongue cutely, but she still had that suspicious look on her face.

"Go wash some fruit for your mother to eat. Xiao Tang got it at the door." Lao Ye pointed to a few plastic bags that Tang Zhendong conveniently placed there at the door.

"Xiao Tang, come whenever you come, but don't bring anything with you." Mrs. Ye was also an honest person, and Tang Zhendong could feel the sincerity in her eyes.

"Okay, sister-in-law, I will only come with my belly next time, haha."

"Xiao Tang, have I told your sister-in-law about her illness?" Old Ye was entangled in this issue. He thought about it for a long time, but he couldn't figure out when he told Tang Zhendong about Ye Xian's mother's illness.

"Um, Lao Ye, have you forgotten what you said?" Tang Zhendong could only make a fool of himself. Naturally, he couldn't say that he hadn't entered the house yet. He could tell these things just by looking at Feng Shui, so he could only argue with Lao Ye.

"Oh, I really don't remember. I thought you could see a doctor before!"

"You Lao Ye, you are so sick that you seek medical treatment. Xiao Tang is not in this profession, how can you treat a doctor?" Huang Xiuqin said angrily.

"The fruits are here, here are the fresh dragon fruits, here are the olives, here are the longans, oh, and there are papayas. Brother Tang brought a lot of fruits, haha." Ye Xian took several plates, peeled some of the ones that needed to be peeled, cut them, put them on the plates, and just eat them directly.

"Xiao Tang, it's really not easy for you. These fruits are so expensive. You are not allowed to bring anything with you next time, do you hear me?" Huang Xiuqin is a person who knows how to live a good life, and he also lives a very frugal life. These southern fruits are not cheap in the north.Although she has never eaten it, they are all on display in supermarkets and she knows the prices.

"I know, sister-in-law, next time I will only bring my mouth and belly." Tang Zhendong smiled.

But Ye Xian looked at Tang Zhendong, "You know how to treat diseases? Did you really tell that my mother has a heart disease?" When Ye Xian was washing the fruits, she listened with all her ears in the kitchen, and asked impatiently when she came out.

"Xianxian, don't talk nonsense." Huang Xiuqin patted her daughter's hand gently.

"Haha, sister-in-law, I really know how to treat simple diseases, but I don't know if I can treat this disease well?" In fact, Tang Zhendong was more than 80% sure about this disease.

While Tang Zhendong was sitting, he had already looked over the Feng Shui decorations of Lao Ye's family, and he also found out the problems with Lao Ye's family's Feng Shui.Then, in terms of cooperation, I can get some traditional Chinese medicine for Mrs. Ye to strengthen her body and strengthen her vitality. Then the disease will actually not be a big deal.

"Ah? Xiao Tang, are you really good at treating doctors? Why have I never heard you talk about it?" Lao Ye was shocked.He could only show his shock at something in a field he had never been exposed to before.

You must know that your wife's disease caused her to faint twice at home, both because she was discovered in time, otherwise her life would be in danger.I also went to a big hospital to get checked for this disease. The hospital said that a heart bypass surgery would cost at least hundreds of thousands of yuan, so Lao Ye was also working hard to make money.

But it’s not like I can’t save much because my daughter is in college, and the annual tuition plus living expenses costs at least 20,000 to 30,000 yuan.Although his daughter knows how to be frugal, Lao Ye doesn't want to suffer for his daughter, so he has saved the money for several years, but he still hasn't saved enough.

This time he suddenly heard that Tang Zhendong could cure diseases, and he couldn't help but feel hopeful.You must know that heart bypass surgery in the hospital costs hundreds of thousands, and the operation is risky.And if Tang Zhendong really has some secret ancient prescription, then it is really possible to cure his wife's disease without spending much money.

"I'll try, but I may not be able to succeed." Tang Zhendong didn't dare to be too confident about things he wasn't sure about.After all, I am just familiar with Feng Shui, not a real doctor.

Tang Zhendong carefully observed the Feng Shui of the Ye family: he discovered the problem in the Feng Shui of the Ye family. Feng Shui is a great knowledge, and people without a good brain can never learn Feng Shui.Because Feng Shui is a calculation science, it requires a lot of complicated calculations.

To determine the feng shui of a house, you must first know the Nine Palaces Flying Star.The Nine Palaces is the Nine Palaces Grid, and the Flying Star is used to determine what the lucky star is.

The so-called lucky star indicates which star is lucky this year.The eight lucky stars for the twenty years from 2004 to 2023 are the lucky stars.The calculation of fortune stars is based on the number of movements of Jupiter and Saturn, which belongs to astrology. Tang Zhendong also has considerable experience in astrology, which is mainly based on calculation.

The calculated fortune star is a dead end.In other words, the fortune star changes once every twenty years. As long as the fortune star in these twenty years is calculated, the direction of the flying star can be found.

In fact, every year, every month, every day, and every hour has its own lucky star. If you want to determine the good or bad luck of each hour, you need to be precise about which month, which day, and which hour. Such calculations need to be even more precise.But then again, in many cases, Feng Shui does not have to be accurate to the time, because the calculation is too complicated, and by the time you calculate the time, the time may have passed.

But be sure, if the fortunes of the past twenty years are not accurate, then naturally the following years, months, days and hours will be wrong. If the fortunes of the past twenty years are aligned, then to find the fault, you need to look for the lucky stars of this year. If you want to continue to be accurate, then calculate the months and days.

Of course, Lao Ye's wife Huang Xiuqin's illness was not caused in these three or two months, but several years ago, so there is no need to be so precise. Just find the lucky star of the past twenty years.

After finding the lucky star, that is, the direction where the flying star lies, you can find the direction of the Ninth Palace.After finding the sitting direction of the Nine Palaces, according to the Nine Palaces Bagua, you will naturally find the family members represented in each direction.

The Nine Palaces Grid is divided into east, south, west, north, and then southeast, southwest, northeast, and northwest, a total of eight directions. These eight directions match the Eight Diagrams such as Qian and Kun, and together with the middle palace in the middle, they just form the Nine Palaces Grid.

Take the Ye family for example, the southwest represents the mother, which is Huang Xiuqin, and the mother represents Kun in the Bagua. Kun belongs to earth, which means that the southwest representing Huang Xiuqin must be suitable for the earth environment and match the earth.

The five elements that match earth are wood and water.Wood overcomes earth, and earth overcomes water.In other words, the southwest of the Ye family is suitable for soil, but not for the presence of wood.There happened to be a pot of tiger orchid placed on the window sill in the southwest of Ye's house. This pot of tiger orchid happened to correspond to the five elements of wood and earth. A tiger orchid grew out of the center of the earth. The center of the earth corresponds to the heart of Kun Gua. Doesn't this mean that there is something wrong with the heart in the center of Huang Xiuqin?
